entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts (loi L/2021/032/AN, applicable 1 January 2022) + LF 2025 (L/2024/023/CNT)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes (fixed duty by turnover class + 15 % of rental value)
entries.statute: CGI (loi L/2021/032/AN) art. 289, 296, 300 bis; LF 2025 (L/2024/0235/CNT) and LFR 2024 do not amend them; LF 2022-2024 not held
entries.doc: art. 300 bis: 1st class (turnover of the previous year at least 10 bn GNF) fixed duty 10 000 000; 2nd (5-10 bn) 5 000 000; 3rd (3-5 bn) 3 000 000; 4th (800 M-3 bn) 2 000 000; proportional duty 15 % of the rental value (art. 296: highest of the lease, comparison and 10 % of the market value), never below a third of the fixed duty (art. 296-IV).
unsupported: industrial establishments 5 % and extraction / convention companies 10 % (art. 300 bis III-IV)

turnover below 800 M: the printed 5th class reads 'turnover below 1 000 000 000 GNF: outside the patente', inconsistent with the 4th class floor of 800 M (layout loss in the official PDF): no charge modelled below 800 M

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: GN: the general tax code held (cgi2021.txt, 664k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: GN: the general tax code held (cgi2021.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus de capitaux mobiliers, dividends to resident individuals (15 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2021 (loi L/2021/0032) art. 170, 189 (LF 2025 L/2024/0235/CNT checked: art. 170-195 not amended; LF 2022-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 189: income distributed to individuals domiciled in Guinea is withheld at 15 % of the amount distributed.

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus de capitaux mobiliers, interest (15 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2021 art. 190 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 190: interest from fixed-income investments paid to resident individuals is withheld at 15 %, bond lots included; interest on savings accounts and term deposits of more than three months with banks is outside the withholding (art. 190 II).
unsupported: interest on savings accounts and bank term deposits over three months is not withheld (art. 190 II): the household's interest is taken to be other interest

entries.name: Impôt sur les plus-values immobilières non professionnelles (15 % final levy)
entries.statute: CGI 2021 art. 162-163 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 162: gain = sale price less taxes and deed costs borne by the seller, less the acquisition price; art. 163: final proportional levy of 15 % of the taxable gain.
unsupported: exemptions and the acquisition value by comparison when no deed exists (art. 162 IV)

entries.name: Versement forfaitaire sur les salaires (6 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2021 art. 201 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 201: individuals and companies employing staff in Guinea pay 6 % of the total wages, allowances and emoluments actually paid.
unsupported: taxe d'apprentissage 2 % of wages (art. 210), due only by employers not subject to the 1,5 % vocational-training contribution (art. 206 3°): which applies is set outside the CGI

entries.name: Contribution foncière unique, owner-occupied housing (5 % of annual rental value)
entries.statute: CGI 2021 art. 264-265 1° (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 264: base = real annual rental value (for housing, the rent of a similar property; for commercial use 10 % of 70 % of cost); art. 265: 5 % for housing occupied by the owner or not let, 10 % for professional premises occupied by the owner, 15 % for let property.
unsupported: 10 % for professional premises occupied by the owner (art. 265 2°)

entries.name: Contribution foncière unique, let property (15 % of annual rental value)
entries.doc: art. 265 3°: let property 15 % of the real annual rental value (other buildings of the household are taken as let).

entries.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutation à titre onéreux d'immeubles (5 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2021 art. 534 II, tariff I (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 534 II tariff I: sale of immovables 5 % of the value stated in the deed; 2 % for buildings bought for demolition and rebuilding, land bought to build housing, and industrial premises.

entries.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (donations, successions)
entries.why: the tariff row for gifts and successions (direct line / spouses 'droit progressif', non-relatives 20 % / 30 %) is garbled in the two-column extraction; the progressive scale was not located

entries.name: CNSS employer contributions (18 % up to 2 500 000 GNF a month)
entries.statute: CNSS Guinée, page 'Cotisations sociales employeurs' as captured on 8 May 2025 (Wayback 20250508102103; page last modified 18 August 2023; R4/fetch/p19/gn_cnss_wb20250508.html): the same ceiling, floor and rates as the held 2026 copy (gn/law/w5/gn_cnss_cotisations_employeurs.html) [text version: 2023 page as served in May 2025]
entries.doc: CNSS: 'Le plafond est de 2 500 000 GNF Le plancher est de 550 000 GNF ... Il représente 23 % du salaire soumis à cotisation ... Employeur 18 % Salarié 5 %' (family 6 %, work accidents 4 %, health 6,5 %, pensions 6,5 %).
